title: Qantas plans to cut 850 jobs
summary: Australian airline Qantas plans to eliminate around 850 jobs and outsource several corporate functions to consulting firm Accenture, with most of the work expected to move to teams in India. The proposed cuts will affect approximately 3 per cent of the airline’s Australian workforce. The
llm_summary: Qantas is set to shed about 850 positions—roughly 3 % of its Australian staff—and shift several corporate functions to Accenture, with much of the work being off‑shored to teams in India. The move is part of a multi‑year partnership aimed at streamlining operations and cutting costs.
